description: Replication files join water-utility workforce and performance information with service-area data and an R script for a published analysis. This resource is provided by Saywitz, Robin Rose. Coverage is national as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists R, TAB formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC0 1.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The service-area data assume people are uniformly distributed within each area. That approximation matters for demographic interpretation. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
